The last completed Figma import used the preceding SVG, normalized every text fragment to Inter Regular and differed from its then-current clean Wasm snapshot by 5.597%.

Figma weight preservation and current raster parity therefore remain unmeasured and the product/Figma gate remains NO-GO.
